Value | Type
----: | --------
    0 | fighting
    1 | flying
    2 | poison
    3 | ground
    4 | rock
    5 | bug
    6 | ghost
    7 | steel
    8 | fire
    9 | water
   10 | grass
   11 | electric
   12 | psychic
   13 | ice
   14 | dragon
   15 | dark

effect: Inflicts regular damage.

effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a 30% chance to burn the target.

effect: Inflicts regular damage.

effect: Inflicts regular damage.

effect: Inflicts regular damage.

effect: Inflicts regular damage.

effect: Inflicts regular damage.

effect: Inflicts regular damage.

name: アストラルビット

effect: Inflicts regular damage.

name: ぶきみなじゅもん

effect: Inflicts regular damage.

name: フェイタルクロー
desc: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws, aiming to land a critical hit. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or drowsy.

name: バリアーラッシュ
desc: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This may also raise the user’s defensive stats.

name: パワーシフト
desc: 説明なし

name: がんせきアックス
desc: The user swings its stone axes at the target, aiming to land a critical hit. Stone splinters left behind by this attack continue to damage the target for several turns.

name: はるのあらし
desc: The user attacks by wrapping the target in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This move’s additional effects depend on the user’s form.

name: しんぴのちから
desc: The user strengthens itself with a mysterious power. If it excels in offense, its offensive stats are raised. If it excels in defense, its defensive stats are raised.

name: だいふんげき
desc: The user rampages and spews vicious flames to inflict damage on the target, then becomes fixated on using this move.

name: ウェーブタックル
desc: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user and raises the user’s action speed.

name: クロロブラスト
desc: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user and lowers the user's action speed.

name: ひょうざんおろし
desc: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage.

name: しょうりのまい
desc: The user performs a dance to usher in victory. This raises the user’s offensive and defensive stats and increases the damage dealt by the user’s moves by 50 percent.

name: ぶちかまし
desc: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s defensive stats.

name: どくばりセンボン
desc: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

name: オーラウイング
desc: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings. This also raises the user's action speed. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

name: うらみつらみ
desc: The user attacks its target with spine-chilling resentment. This may also leave the target with frostbite. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

name: たてこもる
desc: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, raising its defensive stats. Incoming moves also become more likely to miss.

name: ３ぼんのや
desc: The user delivers an axe kick, then fires three arrows. This raises the chance of its future attacks landing critical hits and also lowers the target's defensive stats.

name: ひゃっきやこう
desc: The user attacks with myriad fireballs. This may also leave the target with a burn. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

name: ひけん・ちえなみ
desc: The user slashes its shell blade at the target, aiming to land a critical hit. Shell splinters left behind by this attack will continue to damage the target for several turns.

name: こがらしあらし
desc: The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble. This may also leave the target with frostbite.

name: かみなりあらし
desc: The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

name: ねっさのあらし
desc: The user attacks by wrapping the target in fierce winds and searingly hot sand. This also leaves the target with a burn.

name: みかづきのいのり
desc: The user heals its own status conditions and restores its HP. Incoming moves also become more likely to miss.

name: ブレイブチャージ
desc: The user lifts its spirits, healing its own status conditions and raising its offensive and defensive stats.

name: テラバースト
desc: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

name: スレッドトラップ
desc: The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from damage while lowering the Speed stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.

name: かかとおとし
desc: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.

name: おはかまいり
desc: The user attacks to avenge its allies. The more defeated allies there are in the user's party, the greater the move's power.

name: ルミナコリジョン
desc: The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

name: いっちょうあがり
desc: The user attacks with elegant poise. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts one of the user's stats based on the Tatsugiri's form.

name: ジェットパンチ
desc: The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

name: ハバネロエキス
desc: The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target's Attack stat and harshly lowering the target's Defense stat.

name: ホイールスピン
desc: The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user's Speed stat.

name: ネズミざん
desc: The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target one to ten times in a row.

name: アイススピナー
desc: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

name: きょけんとつげき
desc: The user throws its entire body into a reckless charge. After this move is used, attacks on the user cannot miss and will inflict double damage until the user’s next turn.

name: さいきのいのり
desc: The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon's max HP.

name: しおづけ
desc: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.

name: トリプルダイブ
desc: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.

name: キラースピン
desc: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.

name: うつしえ
desc: The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.

name: みをけずる
desc: The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats by using its own HP.

name: ドゲザン
desc: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.

name: トリックフラワー
desc: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.

name: フレアソング
desc: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

name: アクアステップ
desc: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

name: レイジングブル

name: ゴールドラッシュ

name: サイコブレイド

name: ハイドロスチーム
desc: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent.

name: カタストロフィ

name: アクセルブレイク

name: イナズマドライブ

desc: 説明なし

name: とびつく
